writeup: Woot has the HyperX Alloy Origins Core TKL mechanical keyboard new for $59.99, and code PCGAMING drops it to $47.99 through 11/11. It has a full aluminum body, a detachable USB-C cable and a choice of HyperX Aqua tactile or Red linear switches. Newegg and HyperX's own site both charge $104.99, so the code price saves about $57. Limit 3 per customer and stock is very low.
